deepseek7b.method_note: Patch top or random source units from donor into baseline at answer-site source tensors. Attention units are o_proj input head slices; MLP units are down_proj input activation channels. Top source units are ranked by Phase786-style signed readout contribution.
deepseek7b.strict_interpretation: This phase is a first causal validation of architecture source units. It validates answer-site source-unit intervention only; it still does not prove full Q/K/V or cross-position semantic fibers.
deepseek7b.title: Source Unit Causal Validation for Signed Subspace
